## /server/src/services/render.service.ts

```typescript
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import type { ChartResult } from '../core';

const DIZHI = ['子', '丑', '寅', '卯', '辰', '巳', '午', '未', '申', '酉', '戌', '亥'];

interface RenderOptions {
  chart: ChartResult;
  analysis?: Record<string, unknown>;
  name?: string;
  currentYear?: number;
}

export function renderPoster(options: RenderOptions): string {
  const { chart, analysis = {}, name = '', currentYear } = options;
  const templatePath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'templates', 'report-zonghe-poster.html');
  const template = fs.readFileSync(templatePath, 'utf-8');
  const chartFlat = chartToFlat(chart, currentYear);
  const analysisFlat = analysisToFlat(analysis);
  const data = { ...chartFlat, ...analysisFlat };
  if (name) data['name'] = name;
  return renderTemplate(template, data);
}

function calcVirtualAge(birthYear: number, currentYear: number): number {
  return currentYear - birthYear + 1;
}

function pad(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

function chartToFlat(chart: any, currentYear?: number): Record<string, any> {
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  const bi = chart.bazi.birthInfo;
  const bz = chart.bazi;
  const zw = chart.ziwei;
  currentYear = currentYear || new Date().getFullYear();
  const virtualAge = calcVirtualAge(bi.year, currentYear);

  out['meta.solar_date'] = bi.year + '-' + pad(bi.month) + '-' + pad(bi.day) + ' ' + pad(bi.hour) + ':' + pad(bi.minute);
  if (zw.lunarDate) {
    out['meta.lunar_date'] = zw.lunarDate.year + '年' + zw.lunarDate.monthCn + '月' + zw.lunarDate.dayCn;
  } else {
    out['meta.lunar_date'] = '-';
  }
  out['meta.gender_full'] = bi.gender === 'male' ? '男（' + (zw.yinYang || '') + '）' : '女（' + (zw.yinYang || '') + '）';
  out['meta.age_virtual'] = virtualAge.toString();
  out['meta.current_year'] = currentYear.toString();
  const now = new Date();
  out['meta.gen_time'] = now.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(now.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(now.getDate()) + ' ' + pad(now.getHours()) + ':' + pad(now.getMinutes());
  out['meta.yinyang'] = zw.yinYang || '-';

  const MING_ZHU: any = {'子':'贪狼','丑':'巨门','寅':'禄存','卯':'文曲','辰':'廉贞','巳':'武曲','午':'破军','未':'武曲','申':'廉贞','酉':'文曲','戌':'禄存','亥':'巨门'};
  const SHEN_ZHU: any = {'子':'火星','丑':'天相','寅':'天梁','卯':'天同','辰':'文昌','巳':'天机','午':'火星','未':'天相','申':'天梁','酉':'天同','戌':'文昌','亥':'天机'};
  const mingDizhi = zw.gongs[0]?.dizhi;
  const shenDizhi = DIZHI[zw.shenGongIndex];
  out['ziwei.ming_zhu'] = MING_ZHU[mingDizhi] || '-';
  out['ziwei.shen_zhu'] = SHEN_ZHU[shenDizhi] || '-';
  out['ziwei.zi_dou_jun'] = zw.ziDouJun || '-';
  out['ziwei.wuxing_ju'] = zw.wuXingJu?.name || '-';


  // === 八字四柱 (匹配原始模板 {{bazi.柱.字段}}) ===
  const sz = bz.siZhu;
  const cg = bz.cangGan || {};
  const nayinData = bz.naYin || {};
  const zsData = bz.zhangSheng || {};

  ['year','month','day','hour'].forEach(p => {
    const pillar = sz[p];
    out['bazi.'+p+'.gan'] = pillar.gan;
    out['bazi.'+p+'.zhi'] = pillar.zhi;
    out['bazi.'+p+'.naYin'] = nayinData[p] || '';
    out['bazi.'+p+'.zhangSheng'] = zsData[p] || '';
    out['bazi.'+p+'.shiShen'] = '';
    out['bazi.'+p+'.ziZuo'] = '';
    // cangGan HTML
    const cgArr = cg[p] || [];
    out['bazi.'+p+'.cangGanHtml'] = cgArr.map((x:any) => 
      '<span>' + x.gan + '<small>(' + (x.shiShen||'') + ')</small></span>'
    ).join('');
    // Also keep underscore versions for my table
    out['bazi.'+p+'_gan'] = pillar.gan;
    out['bazi.'+p+'_zhi'] = pillar.zhi;
  });
  out['bazi.day_master'] = bz.dayMaster;
  out['bazi.dayMaster'] = bz.dayMaster;
  out['bazi.dayunStart'] = bz.dayunStart || '';

  // === 紫微十二宫 (匹配原始模板 {{gongs.地支.*}}) ===
  zw.gongs.forEach((g: any) => {
    const branch = g.dizhi; // 巳,午,未,申,酉,戌,亥,子,丑,寅,卯,辰
    if (!branch) return;
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.flag'] = g.gong === '命宫' ? '命' : (g.gong === '身宫' ? '身' : '');
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.name'] = g.gong || '';
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.shenBadge'] = g.gong === '身宫' ? '身' : '';
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.ganzhi'] = (g.tiangan||'') + (g.dizhi||'');
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.mainStarsHtml'] = (g.mainStars || []).map((s: string) => '<span>'+s+'</span>').join('') || '';
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.auxStars'] = (g.auxStars || []).join(' · ') || '';
    out['gongs.'+branch+'.smallStars'] = '';
    if (g.sihua && g.sihua.length > 0) {
      out['gongs.'+branch+'.sihua'] = g.sihua.map((s: any) => s.star+s.hua).join(' · ');
    } else {
      out['gongs.'+branch+'.sihua'] = '';
    }
    if (g.daXian) {
      out['gongs.'+branch+'.daxian_range'] = (g.daXian.startAge||'')+'-'+(g.daXian.endAge||'')+'岁 '+(g.daXian.ganZhi?.gan||'')+(g.daXian.ganZhi?.zhi||'');
    } else {
      out['gongs.'+branch+'.daxian_range'] = '';
    }
  });

  // 四化星
  const sihuaStars: any = {};
  zw.gongs.forEach((g: any) => {
    (g.sihua || []).forEach((s: any) => {
      sihuaStars[s.hua] = (sihuaStars[s.hua] || []).concat(s.star);
    });
  });
  out['sihuaStars.lu'] = (sihuaStars['禄'] || []).join('·') || '—';
  out['sihuaStars.quan'] = (sihuaStars['权'] || []).join('·') || '—';
  out['sihuaStars.ke'] = (sihuaStars['科'] || []).join('·') || '—';
  out['sihuaStars.ji'] = (sihuaStars['忌'] || []).join('·') || '—';


  const en = bz.enrichment;
  out['core.geju'] = en?.格局?.primary || '-';
  out['core.geju_confidence'] = en?.格局?.confidence || '-';
  out['core.wangshuai_verdict'] = en?.旺衰?.verdict || '-';
  out['core.wangshuai_score'] = en?.旺衰?.score?.toString() || '-';
  const ws = en?.旺衰?.score ?? 0;
  out['core.wangshuai_pos_pct'] = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((ws + 10) * 5))).toString();
  const tc = en?.调候用神 || [];
  out['core.tiaohou.0'] = tc[0] || '-';
  out['core.tiaohou.1'] = tc[1] || '-';
  out['core.tiaohou_confidence'] = '高';

  const yl = en?.五行旺相 || {};
  for (const k of ['木','火','土','金','水']) out['core.yueling.' + k] = yl[k] || '-';

  const wx = en?.五行统计?.withCangGan || en?.五行统计 || {木:0,火:0,土:0,金:0,水:0};
  for (const k of ['木','火','土','金','水']) {
    out['core.wuxing.' + k] = (typeof wx[k] === 'number' ? Math.round(wx[k] * 10) / 10 : wx[k]) ?? '-';
  }
  const wxMax = Math.max(...['木','火','土','金','水'].map(k => +wx[k] || 0)) || 1;
  for (const k of ['木','火','土','金','水']) out['core.wuxing_pct.' + k] = Math.round(((+wx[k] || 0) / wxMax) * 100);

  if (bi.name) out['name'] = bi.name;

  // === 头部回退值 ===
  if (!out['meta.archetype_name'] || out['meta.archetype_name'] === '-') {
    const mingStars = (zw.gongs[0]?.mainStars || []).join('') || '';
    const pattern = en?.格局?.primary || '';
    out['meta.archetype_name'] = mingStars ? (mingStars + '坐命' + (pattern ? ' · ' + pattern : '')) : ((bz.dayMaster || '') + '日主' + (pattern ? ' · ' + pattern : ''));
  }
  if (!out['meta.axis_oneliner'] || out['meta.axis_oneliner'] === '-') {
    const dm = bz.dayMaster || '';
    const ws = en?.旺衰?.verdict || '';
    const ms = (zw.gongs[0]?.mainStars || []).join('') || '';
    const mg = (zw.gongs[0]?.tiangan || '') + (zw.gongs[0]?.dizhi || '');
    const pattern = en?.格局?.primary || '';
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (dm && ws) parts.push(dm + '日主' + ws);
    if (ms && mg) parts.push(ms + '坐命' + mg);
    if (pattern) parts.push(pattern);
    out['meta.axis_oneliner'] = parts.length > 0 ? parts.join('，') : '';
  }
  ['year','month','day','hour'].forEach(p => {
    if (!out['bazi.'+p+'.ziZuo'] || out['bazi.'+p+'.ziZuo'] === '') out['bazi.'+p+'.ziZuo'] = '—';
    if (!out['bazi.'+p+'.shiShen'] || out['bazi.'+p+'.shiShen'] === '') out['bazi.'+p+'.shiShen'] = '—';
  });


  // === 两盘主轴印证 ===
  out['axes.bazi_main'] = (bz.dayMaster || '') + '日主，' + (en?.格局?.primary || '普通格局') + '，日主' + (en?.旺衰?.verdict || '中和') + '。' + ((en?.调候用神||[]).length > 0 ? '调候用神：' + (en?.调候用神||[]).join('、') + '。' : '');
  out['axes.ziwei_main'] = '命宫' + (zw.gongs[0]?.tiangan||'') + (zw.gongs[0]?.dizhi||'') + '，主星' + ((zw.gongs[0]?.mainStars||[]).join('、')||'无') + '，' + (zw.wuXingJu?.name||'') + '局。';

  // === 大运流年 (section_02 + dayun table) ===
  const dayun = bz.dayun || [];
  const dayunLen = Math.min(dayun.length, 10);
  for (let i = 0; i < dayunLen; i++) {
    const d = dayun[i];
    const startYr = d ? (d.startYear || (d.startAge||0) + bi.year) : 0;
    const endYr = d ? (d.endYear || startYr + 9) : 0;
    const gz = d ? (d.ganZhi.gan + d.ganZhi.zhi) : '';
    const range = d ? (d.startAge + '-' + d.endAge + '岁') : '';
    const fullRange = d ? (startYr + '-' + endYr + ' (' + range + ')') : '';
    const isCurrent = (d && d.startYear <= currentYear && d.endYear >= currentYear) || d?.isCurrent;
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.range'] = fullRange || '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.gz'] = gz || '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.shishen'] = (d?.ganShiShen || d?.zhiShiShen || gz) || '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.current_class'] = isCurrent ? 'current' : '';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.age_range'] = range || '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.gz'] = gz || '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.shishen'] = (d?.ganShiShen || d?.zhiShiShen || gz) || '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.current_class'] = isCurrent ? 'current' : '';
  }
  for (let i = dayunLen; i < 10; i++) {
    out['dayun.'+i+'.age_range'] = '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.gz'] = '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.shishen'] = '-';
    out['dayun.'+i+'.current_class'] = '';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.range'] = '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.gz'] = '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.shishen'] = '-';
    out['section_02.bazi.'+i+'.current_class'] = '';
  }

  let currentDayun = null;
  for (const d of dayun) {
    if (d.startYear <= currentYear && d.endYear >= currentYear) { currentDayun = d; break; }
  }
  if (!currentDayun) currentDayun = dayun[0];
  const liunianList = currentDayun?.liuNian || [];
  const liunianLen = Math.min(liunianList.length, 10);
  out['liunian_dayun_label'] = currentDayun
    ? (currentDayun.ganZhi.gan + currentDayun.ganZhi.zhi + '大运（' + currentDayun.startAge + '-' + currentDayun.endAge + '岁）')
    : '—';
  for (let i = 0; i < liunianLen; i++) {
    const ln = liunianList[i];
    out['liunian.'+i+'.year'] = ln.year?.toString() || '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.age'] = ln.age?.toString() || '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.gz'] = (ln.ganZhi?.gan || '') + (ln.ganZhi?.zhi || '') || '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.shishen'] = (ln.ganZhi?.gan || '') + (ln.ganZhi?.zhi || '') || '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.current_class'] = (ln.year === currentYear) ? 'current' : '';
  }
  for (let i = liunianLen; i < 10; i++) {
    out['liunian.'+i+'.year'] = '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.age'] = '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.gz'] = '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.shishen'] = '-';
    out['liunian.'+i+'.current_class'] = '';
  }

  const dims = ['career','wealth','marriage','children','family','health'];
  dims.forEach(dim => {
    if (!out['dim.'+dim+'.bazi'] || out['dim.'+dim+'.bazi'] === '-') out['dim.'+dim+'.bazi'] = '（八字维度待AI分析）';
    if (!out['dim.'+dim+'.ziwei'] || out['dim.'+dim+'.ziwei'] === '-') out['dim.'+dim+'.ziwei'] = '（紫微维度待AI分析）';
    if (!out['dim.'+dim+'.verdict'] || out['dim.'+dim+'.verdict'] === '-') out['dim.'+dim+'.verdict'] = '待两盘印证';
    if (!out['dim.'+dim+'.fused'] || out['dim.'+dim+'.fused'] === '-') out['dim.'+dim+'.fused'] = '待AI融合分析';
  });
  for (let i=0; i<3; i++) {
    if (!out['conflicts.'+i+'.point'] || out['conflicts.'+i+'.point'] === '-') out['conflicts.'+i+'.point'] = '待AI冲突检测';
    if (!out['conflicts.'+i+'.bazi'] || out['conflicts.'+i+'.bazi'] === '-') out['conflicts.'+i+'.bazi'] = '—';
    if (!out['conflicts.'+i+'.ziwei'] || out['conflicts.'+i+'.ziwei'] === '-') out['conflicts.'+i+'.ziwei'] = '—';
    if (!out['conflicts.'+i+'.impact'] || out['conflicts.'+i+'.impact'] === '-') out['conflicts.'+i+'.impact'] = '—';
    if (!out['conflicts.'+i+'.advice'] || out['conflicts.'+i+'.advice'] === '-') out['conflicts.'+i+'.advice'] = '—';
  }
  if (!out['final.life_axis'] || out['final.life_axis'] === '-') {
    out['final.life_axis'] = (bz.dayMaster||'') + '日主，' + (en?.格局?.primary||'普通格局') + '，命宫主星' + ((zw.gongs[0]?.mainStars||[]).join('、')||'—') + '。完整报告中由AI综合两盘深度分析。';
  }
  for (let i=0; i<5; i++) {
    if (!out['final.nodes.'+i+'.age']) out['final.nodes.'+i+'.age'] = '—';
    if (!out['final.nodes.'+i+'.year']) out['final.nodes.'+i+'.year'] = '—';
    if (!out['final.nodes.'+i+'.event']) out['final.nodes.'+i+'.event'] = '（待AI分析关键人生节点）';
  }
  for (let i=0; i<3; i++) {
    if (!out['final.risks.'+i+'.range']) out['final.risks.'+i+'.range'] = '—';
    if (!out['final.risks.'+i+'.desc']) out['final.risks.'+i+'.desc'] = '（待AI分析高风险窗口）';
  }
  for (let i=0; i<2; i++) {
    if (!out['final.leverage.'+i+'.title']) out['final.leverage.'+i+'.title'] = '—';
    if (!out['final.leverage.'+i+'.desc']) out['final.leverage.'+i+'.desc'] = '（待AI分析优势放大策略）';
  }
  for (let i=0; i<4; i++) {
    if (!out['final.advice.'+i]) out['final.advice.'+i] = '（待AI生成建议）';
  }
  if (!out['section_01.text'] || out['section_01.text'] === '-') {
    out['section_01.text'] = '命主' + (bz.dayMaster||'') + '日主，' + (en?.格局?.primary||'格局待定') + '。完整命盘已生成，主轴印证结论待AI深度解读。';
    out['section_01.word_count'] = '待解读';
  }
  if (!out['section_02.conclusion'] || out['section_02.conclusion'] === '-') {
    out['section_02.conclusion'] = '大运流转已排定，阶段印证分析待AI完成。';
  }
  const defaultStrengths = [
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘优势特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'},
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘优势特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'},
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘优势特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'}
  ];
  const defaultWeaknesses = [
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘隐忧特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'},
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘隐忧特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'},
    {title:'待AI分析', desc:'命盘隐忧特征待AI从八字与紫微双盘交叉验证后生成。'}
  ];
  for (let i=0; i<3; i++) {
    if (!out['strengths.'+i+'.title'] || out['strengths.'+i+'.title'] === '-') out['strengths.'+i+'.title'] = defaultStrengths[i].title;
    if (!out['strengths.'+i+'.desc'] || out['strengths.'+i+'.desc'] === '-') out['strengths.'+i+'.desc'] = defaultStrengths[i].desc;
    if (!out['weaknesses.'+i+'.title'] || out['weaknesses.'+i+'.title'] === '-') out['weaknesses.'+i+'.title'] = defaultWeaknesses[i].title;
    if (!out['weaknesses.'+i+'.desc'] || out['weaknesses.'+i+'.desc'] === '-') out['weaknesses.'+i+'.desc'] = defaultWeaknesses[i].desc;
  }
  const confLabels = ['bazi','ziwei','consistency','stability'];
  const confDefaults = ['中','中','待测','待测'];
  const confScores = ['0.65','0.60','0.50','0.50'];
  confLabels.forEach((k,i) => {
    if (!out['confidence.'+k+'_level'] || out['confidence.'+k+'_level'] === '-') out['confidence.'+k+'_level'] = confDefaults[i];
    if (!out['confidence.'+k+'_score'] || out['confidence.'+k+'_score'] === '-') out['confidence.'+k+'_score'] = confScores[i];
  });
  if (!out['confidence.note'] || out['confidence.note'] === '-') out['confidence.note'] = '当前为基础排盘结果。完整报告由AI深度分析后更新置信度评估。';

  return out;
}

function analysisToFlat(analysis: any): Record<string, any> {
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  const setIf = (key: string, val: any) => {
    if (val !== undefined && val !== null && val !== '' && val !== '-') out[key] = val;
  };
  if (analysis.marketing) {
    setIf('meta.archetype_name', analysis.marketing.title);
    setIf('meta.axis_oneliner', analysis.marketing.hook);
  }
  if (analysis.meta) {
    setIf('meta.archetype_name', analysis.meta.archetype_name);
    setIf('meta.axis_oneliner', analysis.meta.axis_oneliner);
  }
  if (analysis.axes) {
    setIf('axes.bazi_main', analysis.axes.bazi_main);
    setIf('axes.ziwei_main', analysis.axes.ziwei_main);
  }
  if (analysis.consistency) setIf('ziwei.consistency', analysis.consistency);

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const s = analysis.strengths?.[i];
    if (s) { setIf('strengths.' + i + '.title', s.title); setIf('strengths.' + i + '.desc', s.desc); }
    const w = analysis.weaknesses?.[i];
    if (w) { setIf('weaknesses.' + i + '.title', w.title); setIf('weaknesses.' + i + '.desc', w.desc); }
  }

  if (analysis.section_01) {
    setIf('section_01.text', analysis.section_01.text);
    setIf('section_01.word_count', analysis.section_01.word_count);
  }
  if (analysis.section_02) {
    setIf('section_02.conclusion', analysis.section_02.conclusion);
  }

  const dims = ['career','wealth','marriage','children','family','health'];
  for (const k of dims) {
    const d = analysis.dim?.[k];
    if (d) {
      setIf('dim.' + k + '.bazi', d.bazi);
      setIf('dim.' + k + '.ziwei', d.ziwei);
      setIf('dim.' + k + '.verdict', d.verdict);
      setIf('dim.' + k + '.verdict_class', d.verdict_class);
      setIf('dim.' + k + '.fused', d.fused);
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const c = analysis.conflicts?.[i];
    if (c) {
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.point', c.point);
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.bazi', c.bazi);
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.ziwei', c.ziwei);
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.impact', c.impact);
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.impact_class', c.impact_class);
      setIf('conflicts.' + i + '.advice', c.advice);
    }
  }

  if (analysis.final) {
    setIf('final.life_axis', analysis.final.life_axis);
    if (analysis.final.nodes) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const n = analysis.final.nodes[i];
        if (n) { setIf('final.nodes.' + i + '.age', n.age); setIf('final.nodes.' + i + '.year', n.year); setIf('final.nodes.' + i + '.event', n.event); }
      }
    }
    if (analysis.final.risks) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const r = analysis.final.risks[i];
        if (r) { setIf('final.risks.' + i + '.range', r.range); setIf('final.risks.' + i + '.desc', r.desc); }
      }
    }
    if (analysis.final.leverage) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const l = analysis.final.leverage[i];
        if (l) { setIf('final.leverage.' + i + '.title', l.title); setIf('final.leverage.' + i + '.desc', l.desc); }
      }
    }
    if (analysis.final.advice) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) setIf('final.advice.' + i, analysis.final.advice[i]);
    }
  }

  if (analysis.confidence) {
    for (const k of ['bazi','ziwei','consistency','stability']) {
      setIf('confidence.' + k + '_level', analysis.confidence[k + '_level']);
      setIf('confidence.' + k + '_score', analysis.confidence[k + '_score']);
    }
    setIf('confidence.note', analysis.confidence.note);
  }

  return out;
}

function renderTemplate(template: string, data: Record<string, any>): string {
  let html = template;
  for (const k of Object.keys(data)) {
    const escaped = k.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    html = html.replace(new RegExp('\\{\\{' + escaped + '\\}\\}', 'g'), String(data[k] ?? '-'));
  }
  html = html.replace(/\{\{[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+\}\}/g, '-');
  return html;
}
```

## /server/src/services/storage.service.ts

```typescript
/**
 * 文件存储服务（抽象层）
 *
 * 当前实现：本地文件系统存储
 * 未来扩展：阿里云 OSS / 腾讯云 COS / Cloudflare R2
 *
 * 使用前配置环境变量（可选，默认本地存储）：
 *   STORAGE_PROVIDER=oss  # local | oss
 *   OSS_ENDPOINT=https://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com
 *   OSS_BUCKET=hundun-mindpan
 *   OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xxx
 *   OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=xxx
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

// ==================== 接口定义 ====================

export interface StorageProvider {
  /** 上传文件，返回公开访问 URL */
  uploadFile(key: string, content: Buffer | string, contentType?: string): Promise<string>;
  /** 获取文件公开 URL */
  getFileUrl(key: string): string;
  /** 删除文件 */
  deleteFile(key: string): Promise<void>;
}

// ==================== 本地存储实现 ====================

class LocalStorageProvider implements StorageProvider {
  private baseDir: string;

  constructor() {
    this.baseDir = process.env.STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH || path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'storage');
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.baseDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.baseDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }

  async uploadFile(key: string, content: Buffer | string, _contentType?: string): Promise<string> {
    const filePath = path.join(this.baseDir, key);
    const dir = path.dirname(filePath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content);
    return this.getFileUrl(key);
  }

  getFileUrl(key: string): string {
    return '/storage/' + key;
  }

  async deleteFile(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const filePath = path.join(this.baseDir, key);
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
    }
  }
}

// ==================== OSS 存储实现（预留） ====================

class OSSStorageProvider implements StorageProvider {
  private get endpoint() { return process.env.OSS_ENDPOINT || ''; }
  private get bucket() { return process.env.OSS_BUCKET || 'hundun-mindpan'; }
  private get accessKeyId() { return process.env.OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || ''; }
  private get accessKeySecret() { return process.env.OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET || ''; }

  async uploadFile(key: string, content: Buffer | string, contentType?: string): Promise<string> {
    // TODO: 集成 ali-oss SDK
    // const OSS = require('ali-oss');
    // const client = new OSS({ ... });
    // await client.put(key, content, { mime: contentType });
    throw new Error('OSS storage not yet implemented. Install ali-oss and configure OSS_* env vars.');
  }

  getFileUrl(key: string): string {
    return 'https://' + this.bucket + '.' + this.endpoint.replace('https://', '') + '/' + key;
  }

  async deleteFile(key: string): Promise<void> {
    throw new Error('OSS storage not yet implemented.');
  }
}

// ==================== StorageService 统一入口 ====================

class StorageService {
  private provider: StorageProvider;

  constructor() {
    const providerName = process.env.STORAGE_PROVIDER || 'local';
    switch (providerName) {
      case 'oss':
        this.provider = new OSSStorageProvider();
        break;
      case 'local':
      default:
        this.provider = new LocalStorageProvider();
        break;
    }
    console.log('[Storage] Using provider:', providerName);
  }

  /** 上传海报 HTML，返回公开 URL */
  async uploadPoster(chartId: string, html: string): Promise<string> {
    return this.provider.uploadFile('posters/' + chartId + '.html', html, 'text/html; charset=utf-8');
  }

  /** 获取海报 URL */
  getPosterUrl(chartId: string): string {
    return this.provider.getFileUrl('posters/' + chartId + '.html');
  }

  /** 上传通用文件 */
  async upload(key: string, content: Buffer | string, contentType?: string): Promise<string> {
    return this.provider.uploadFile(key, content, contentType);
  }

  /** 获取文件 URL */
  getUrl(key: string): string {
    return this.provider.getFileUrl(key);
  }

  /** 删除文件 */
  async delete(key: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.provider.deleteFile(key);
  }
}

export const storage = new StorageService();
export default storage;
```

```html
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; line-height: 1.1;
    transform: rotate(-3deg);
  }
  .title-block { overflow: hidden; } .title-block h1 { font-size: 36px; margin: 0 0 6px; letter-spacing: 4px; font-weight: normal; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; word-break: break-all; }
  .title-block .subtitle { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); letter-spacing: 1px; max-width: 520px; overflow: hidden; }
  .header-right { overflow: hidden; text-align: right;
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .header-right .gen-time { margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .header-right .meta-row {
    display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end;
    margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px;
  }
  .header-right .meta-row span { color: var(--ink); }
  .header-right .meta-row b { color: var(--vermillion); font-weight: normal; }
  .badge-grade { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--jade); color: var(--jade); border-radius: 3px; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 6px; max-width: 280px; overflow: hidden; }

  /* ============ TOP GRID ============ */
  .top-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  /* core-data 独立一行, 全宽 5 卡 */
  .core-data-row {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .info-card {
    background: var(--paper-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 14px 16px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 2;
  }
  .info-card .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  .info-card .icon { color: var(--vermillion); width: 16px; }
  .info-card .key { color: var(--ink-soft); width: 44px; }
  .info-card .val { color: var(--ink); }

  /* core data */
  .section-title {
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;
    margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--ink);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }
  .core-data {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .data-card {
    background: var(--paper-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 10px 12px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .data-card .info-i {
    position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px;
    color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 10px;
  }
  .data-card .label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .data-card .value { font-size: 22px; color: var(--ink); margin: 4px 0; }
  .data-card .value-tiaohou { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
  .data-card .value-tiaohou span {
    display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--jade); color: var(--jade);
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .data-card .conf {
    font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .data-card .score {
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
    color: var(--vermillion); font-size: 14px;
  }
  .slider {
    height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--azure), var(--paper-deep), var(--vermillion));
    margin: 6px 4px 2px; position: relative; border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .slider-mark {
    position: absolute; top: -2px;
    width: 0; height: 0;
    border-left: 4px solid transparent;
    border-right: 4px solid transparent;
    border-top: 5px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .slider-labels {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-faint);
    margin-top: 1px;
  }
  .yueling { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink); }
  .yueling .tag {
    display: inline-block; margin: 0 2px;
    padding: 0 4px; font-size: 11px;
  }
  .wx-bars {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 4px; align-items: end;
    height: 50px; padding: 0 4px;
  }
  .wx-bar {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: end;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .wx-bar .col {
    width: 14px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  }
  .wx-bar .name { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-top: 2px; }
  .wx-bar .num-val { font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-faint); }

  /* right block */
  .right-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
  .axes-block {
    background: var(--paper-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 12px 14px;
  }
  .axes-row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px;
  }
  .axis-box {
    padding: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    border: 1px dashed var(--line-soft);
  }
  .axis-box .label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--vermillion); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .axis-box .text { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.7; }
  .strengths-block {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px;
  }
  .strength-side, .weakness-side {
    background: var(--paper-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }
  .strength-side h4 { color: var(--jade); }
  .weakness-side h4 { color: var(--vermillion); }
  .strength-side h4, .weakness-side h4 {
    margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 12px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  }
  .item {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr;
    gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .item .star { color: var(--jade); }
  .item .x { color: var(--vermillion); }
  .item .t { font-weight: bold; color: var(--ink); display: block; }
  .item .d { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* ============ ZIWEI + BAZI GRID ============ */
  .charts-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .ziwei-pan {
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .ziwei-pan h3, .bazi-pan h3 {
    margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 13px; background: var(--paper-deep);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }
  .ziwei-pan h3 small { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-left: 8px; }
  .ziwei-pan h3 .sh-禄 { color: var(--vermillion); }
  .ziwei-pan h3 .sh-权 { color: var(--azure); }
  .ziwei-pan h3 .sh-科 { color: var(--jade); }
  .ziwei-pan h3 .sh-忌 { color: var(--obsidian); }
  .ziwei-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr);
    height: 540px;
    background: var(--line-soft);
    gap: 1px;
  }
  .palace {
    background: var(--paper);
    padding: 4px 6px;
    font-size: 10px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .palace.ming { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--vermillion); }
  .palace.ming .p-gong { color: var(--vermillion); }
  /* 身宫: 宫名后的内联小徽标, 不绝对定位, 不遮挡内容 */
  .shen-badge {
    display: inline-block; margin-left: 3px;
    color: var(--vermillion); border: 1px solid var(--vermillion);
    border-radius: 2px; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.2;
    padding: 0 2px; vertical-align: middle; font-weight: normal;
  }
  .palace .p-head {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line-soft);
    padding-bottom: 2px; margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .palace .p-head .p-gong-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .palace .p-dizhi { color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .palace .p-gong { font-weight: bold; }
  .palace .p-ganzhi { font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-faint); }
  .palace .main-star {
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .palace .main-star .state {
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-left: 1px;
  }
  .palace .aux-star { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; }
  .palace .small-star { color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .palace .daxian {
    margin-top: auto; padding-top: 4px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-soft);
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .palace.current-daxian .daxian { color: var(--vermillion); font-weight: bold; }
  .sihua-禄 { color: var(--vermillion); }
  .sihua-权 { color: var(--azure); }
  .sihua-科 { color: var(--jade); }
  .sihua-忌 { color: var(--obsidian); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; }
  .sihua-tag {
    display: inline-block; padding: 0 3px;
    border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 8px; margin-left: 1px;
  }

  /* center palace */
  .center-palace {
    grid-column: 2 / 4; grid-row: 2 / 4;
    padding: 14px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: var(--paper);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .center-palace h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 4px; }
  .center-palace .info-line { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 2px 0; }
  .center-palace .pillars {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px;
  }
  .center-palace .pillar {
    background: var(--paper-deep);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 4px 8px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .center-palace .pillar .pname { font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-faint); letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .center-palace .pillar .pgan { font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }
  .center-palace .pillar .pzhi { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* ============ BAZI PAN ============ */
  .bazi-pan { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .bazi-body { padding: 12px; }
  .bazi-pillars {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }
  .b-col {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line-faint);
    padding: 8px 4px; text-align: center;
  }
  .b-col:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .b-head { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .b-shishen { font-size: 11px; color: var(--vermillion); margin: 2px 0; }
  .b-shishen.dayMaster { color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 0 4px; display: inline-block; }
  .b-gan { font-size: 30px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.1; margin: 2px 0; }
  .b-zhi { font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.1; margin: 2px 0; }
  .b-canggan {
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-soft);
    line-height: 1.5; min-height: 50px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-soft); margin-top: 4px;
    padding-top: 4px;
  }
  .b-extra {
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-soft);
    margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 4px;
  }
  .b-extra-row {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin: 1px 0;
  }
  .b-extra-row .ek { color: var(--ink-faint); }

  .dayun-strip, .liunian-strip {
    margin-top: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }
  .strip-head {
    background: var(--paper-deep);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }
  .strip-head .small { font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-left: 6px; }
  .strip-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); }
  .strip-cell {
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line-faint);
    padding: 4px 2px; text-align: center;
    font-size: 9px;
  }
  .strip-cell:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .strip-cell.current { background: rgba(193,67,47,0.08); }
  .strip-cell.current .ages { color: var(--vermillion); font-weight: bold; }
  .strip-cell .gz { font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--ink); }
  .strip-cell .ages { color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .strip-cell .ss { font-size: 8px; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-top: 1px; }
  .strip-cell.current.dayun::after {
    content: "当前"; display: block;
    color: var(--vermillion); font-size: 9px; margin-top: 1px;
  }

  /* ============ NUMBERED SECTIONS ============ */
  .section {
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 14px 18px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .section h2 {
    margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .section h2 .num-box {
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
    padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 11px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
  }
  .row-2col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }

  /* 01 main axis conclusion */
  .axis-conclusion {
    background: var(--paper-card); border-left: 3px solid var(--vermillion);
    padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.9;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .axis-conclusion .wc { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-faint); text-align: right; margin-top: 6px; }

  /* 02 stage timeline */
  .stage-legend { display: flex; gap: 12px; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .stage-legend .dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: middle; }
  .stage-legend .dot.up { background: var(--jade); }
  .stage-legend .dot.flat { background: var(--azure); }
  .stage-legend .dot.down { background: var(--vermillion); }
  .stage-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px repeat(7, 1fr);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: 10px;
  }
  .stage-grid > div { padding: 6px 4px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-faint); text-align: center; }
  .stage-grid > div:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .stage-grid .stage-head { background: var(--paper-deep); font-weight: bold; }
  .stage-grid .sg-label { background: var(--paper-deep); font-size: 11px; text-align: left; padding-left: 8px; }
  .stage-grid .current { background: rgba(193,67,47,0.08); color: var(--vermillion); font-weight: bold; }
  .stage-conclusion {
    background: var(--paper-card); padding: 8px 12px;
    margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.8;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--azure);
  }

  /* 03 cross check */
  .cross-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px repeat(6, 1fr);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: 10px;
  }
  .cross-grid > div { padding: 6px 5px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-faint); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-faint); }
  .cross-grid > div:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .cross-grid .ch { background: var(--paper-deep); text-align: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px; }
  .cross-grid .lh { background: var(--paper-deep); font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; }
  .verdict-tag { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 10px; }
  .verdict-yes { background: rgba(74,124,78,0.15); color: var(--jade); }
  .verdict-partial { background: rgba(201,124,58,0.15); color: var(--warn); }
  .verdict-no { background: rgba(193,67,47,0.15); color: var(--vermillion); }

  /* 04 conflicts */
  .conflict-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr 1fr 60px 1fr;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: 10px;
  }
  .conflict-grid > div { padding: 6px 8px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-faint); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-faint); }
  .conflict-grid > div:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .conflict-grid .ch { background: var(--paper-deep); font-weight: bold; text-align: center; }
  .impact-dot {
    display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: middle;
  }
  .impact-low { background: var(--jade); }
  .impact-mid { background: var(--warn); }
  .impact-high { background: var(--vermillion); }

  /* 05 final conclusion */
  .final-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .final-block {
    background: var(--paper-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }
  .final-block h4 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .final-block .big {
    font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--vermillion);
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .nodes-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 10px; }
  .nodes-list li {
    position: relative; padding-left: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .nodes-list li::before {
    content: "●"; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
    color: var(--vermillion); font-size: 10px;
  }
  .risk-item, .leverage-item, .advice-item {
    font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6;
    padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line-faint);
  }
  .risk-item:last-child, .leverage-item:last-child, .advice-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .risk-item .head { color: var(--vermillion); font-weight: bold; }
  .leverage-item .head { color: var(--jade); font-weight: bold; }
  .advice-item .num {
    display: inline-block; width: 18px; height: 18px;
    background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
    border-radius: 50%; text-align: center; line-height: 18px;
    font-size: 10px; margin-right: 4px;
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
  }

  /* 06 confidence */
  .confidence-row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) 1.5fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .conf-card {
    text-align: center; padding: 8px;
    background: var(--paper-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }
  .conf-card .label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .conf-card .level { font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; margin: 4px 0; }
  .conf-card .score { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; color: var(--vermillion); font-size: 12px; }
  .conf-note {
    background: var(--paper-card); padding: 8px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  /* footer */
  .footer-disclaim {
    text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-faint);
    margin-top: 18px; padding: 14px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px;
  }
  .footer-disclaim .footer-seal {
    color: var(--vermillion); border: 1px solid var(--vermillion);
    padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px;
    transform: rotate(-2deg);
  }
﻿/* ============ MOBILE RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  html, body { font-size: 12px; padding: 8px; }
  body { padding: 8px; min-height: auto; }
  .report { max-width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: none; }
  .header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; text-align: center; }
  .seal { margin: 0 auto; }
  .title-block h1 { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 2px; max-width: 100%; word-break: break-all; }
  .title-block .subtitle { font-size: 11px; max-width: 100%; }
  .header-right { text-align: center; }
  .header-right .meta-row { justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 10px; }
  .badge-grade { max-width: 100%; font-size: 10px; }
  .top-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .info-card { font-size: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; }
  .info-card .row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .core-data { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
  .data-card { padding: 8px 6px; }
  .data-card .value { font-size: 16px; }
  .data-card .label { font-size: 10px; }
  .axes-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .strengths-block { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .charts-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .ziwei-grid { height: auto; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; }
  .palace { font-size: 8px; padding: 3px 4px; min-height: 80px; }
  .palace .main-star { font-size: 9px; }
  .palace .aux-star { font-size: 8px; }
  .palace .small-star { font-size: 7px; }
  .palace .p-head { font-size: 7px; }
  .palace .p-gong { font-size: 8px; }
  .palace .p-ganzhi { font-size: 7px; }
  .palace .daxian { font-size: 7px; }
  .center-palace { grid-column: 2/4; grid-row: 2/4; padding: 8px; }
  .center-palace h4 { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .center-palace .info-line { font-size: 9px; }
  .center-palace .pillars { gap: 4px; }
  .center-palace .pillar { padding: 3px 5px; }
  .center-palace .pillar .pgan { font-size: 11px; }
  .center-palace .pillar .pzhi { font-size: 10px; }
  .ziwei-pan h3, .bazi-pan h3 { font-size: 11px; padding: 6px 8px; }
  .ziwei-pan h3 small { font-size: 8px; display: none; }
  .bazi-body { padding: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .bazi-pillars { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  .b-gan { font-size: 22px; }
  .b-zhi { font-size: 18px; }
  .b-canggan { font-size: 8px; min-height: 30px; }
  .b-head { font-size: 8px; }
  .b-shishen { font-size: 9px; }
  .b-extra-row { font-size: 7px; }
  .dayun-strip, .liunian-strip { overflow-x: auto; }
  .strip-row { min-width: 500px; }
  .strip-cell { font-size: 7px; padding: 3px 1px; }
  .strip-cell .gz { font-size: 9px; }
  .strip-head { font-size: 10px; }
  .section { padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .section h2 { font-size: 12px; gap: 4px; }
  .row-2col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .cross-grid { font-size: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .conflict-grid { font-size: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .stage-grid { font-size: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  .final-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .confidence-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
  .footer-disclaim { flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 10px; }
  .wx-bars { height: 40px; }
  .yueling { font-size: 10px; }
  .axis-conclusion { font-size: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .nodes-list li { font-size: 9px; }
  .risk-item, .leverage-item, .advice-item { font-size: 9px; }
  .stage-conclusion { font-size: 10px; }
  .final-block { padding: 8px 10px; }
  .final-block h4 { font-size: 10px; }
  .final-block .big { font-size: 11px; }
  .conf-card { padding: 6px; }
  .conf-card .label { font-size: 9px; }
  .conf-card .level { font-size: 12px; }
  .conf-card .score { font-size: 10px; }
  .conf-note { font-size: 9px; padding: 6px 8px; }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="report">

  <!-- ============ HEADER ============ -->
  <header class="header">
    <div class="seal">混沌<br>阁</div>
    <div class="title-block">
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px">综合印证报告</div>
      <div class="person-name">{{name}}</div>
      <h1>{{meta.archetype_name}}</h1>
      <div class="subtitle">{{meta.axis_oneliner}}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="header-right">
      <div class="gen-time">生成时间：<span class="num">{{meta.gen_time}}</span></div>
      <div>综合印证评级</div>
      <div class="badge-grade">✓ {{ziwei.consistency}}</div>
      <div class="meta-row">
        <span>命主星：<b>{{ziwei.ming_zhu}}</b></span>
        <span>身主星：<b>{{ziwei.shen_zhu}}</b></span>
      </div>
      <div class="meta-row">
        <span>子年斗君：<b>{{ziwei.zi_dou_jun}}</b></span>
        <span>{{ziwei.wuxing_ju}}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- ============ TOP GRID: info | core | right ============ -->
  <div class="top-grid">

    <!-- left info card -->
    <div class="info-card">
      <div class="row"><span class="icon">☉</span><span class="key">阳历</span><span class="val num">{{meta.solar_date}}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="icon">☽</span><span class="key">农历</span><span class="val">{{meta.lunar_date}}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="icon">⚧</span><span class="key">性别</span><span class="val">{{meta.gender_full}}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="icon">⌛</span><span class="key">年龄</span><span class="val">虚岁 <span class="num">{{meta.age_virtual}}</span>（截至 <span class="num">{{meta.current_year}}</span>）</span></div>
    </div>

    <!-- right block: axes + strengths -->
    <div class="right-block">
      <div class="axes-block">
        <div class="section-title">两盘主轴印证</div>
        <div class="axes-row">
          <div class="axis-box">
            <div class="label">八字主轴</div>
            <div class="text">{{axes.bazi_main}}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="axis-box">
            <div class="label">紫微主轴</div>
            <div class="text">{{axes.ziwei_main}}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="strengths-block">
        <div class="strength-side">
          <h4>★ 三大优势</h4>
          <div class="item"><span class="star">★</span><div><span class="t">{{strengths.0.title}}</span><span class="d">{{strengths.0.desc}}</span></div></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="star">★</span><div><span class="t">{{strengths.1.title}}</span><span class="d">{{strengths.1.desc}}</span></div></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="star">★</span><div><span class="t">{{strengths.2.title}}</span><span class="d">{{strengths.2.desc}}</span></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="weakness-side">
          <h4>⊗ 三大隐忧</h4>
          <div class="item"><span class="x">⊗</span><div><span class="t">{{weaknesses.0.title}}</span><span class="d">{{weaknesses.0.desc}}</span></div></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="x">⊗</span><div><span class="t">{{weaknesses.1.title}}</span><span class="d">{{weaknesses.1.desc}}</span></div></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="x">⊗</span><div><span class="t">{{weaknesses.2.title}}</span><span class="d">{{weaknesses.2.desc}}</span></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ CORE DATA (full-width row) ============ -->
  <div class="core-data-row">
    <div class="section-title">命盘核心数据</div>
    <div class="core-data">
      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="info-i">ⓘ</div>
        <div class="label">格局</div>
        <div class="value">{{core.geju}}</div>
        <div class="conf">置信度：{{core.geju_confidence}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="info-i">ⓘ</div>
        <div class="label">旺衰</div>
        <div class="value">{{core.wangshuai_verdict}}</div>
        <div class="score num">{{core.wangshuai_score}}</div>
        <div class="slider">
          <div class="slider-mark" style="left:{{core.wangshuai_pos_pct}}%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="slider-labels"><span>弱</span><span>中</span><span>旺</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="info-i">ⓘ</div>
        <div class="label">调候用神</div>
        <div class="value-tiaohou" style="margin-top:6px"><span>{{core.tiaohou.0}}</span><span>{{core.tiaohou.1}}</span></div>
        <div class="conf" style="margin-top:8px">置信度：{{core.tiaohou_confidence}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="label">月令旺相</div>
        <div class="yueling" style="margin-top:8px">
          <span class="tag">水{{core.yueling.水}}</span>·<span class="tag">木{{core.yueling.木}}</span>·<span class="tag">金{{core.yueling.金}}</span>·<span class="tag">土{{core.yueling.土}}</span>·<span class="tag">火{{core.yueling.火}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="label">五行统计（含藏干）</div>
        <div class="wx-bars">
          <div class="wx-bar"><div class="col" style="height:{{core.wuxing_pct.木}}%;background:var(--jade)"></div><div class="name">木</div><div class="num-val num">{{core.wuxing.木}}</div></div>
          <div class="wx-bar"><div class="col" style="height:{{core.wuxing_pct.火}}%;background:var(--vermillion)"></div><div class="name">火</div><div class="num-val num">{{core.wuxing.火}}</div></div>
          <div class="wx-bar"><div class="col" style="height:{{core.wuxing_pct.土}}%;background:#a07c4a"></div><div class="name">土</div><div class="num-val num">{{core.wuxing.土}}</div></div>
          <div class="wx-bar"><div class="col" style="height:{{core.wuxing_pct.金}}%;background:#9c9382"></div><div class="name">金</div><div class="num-val num">{{core.wuxing.金}}</div></div>
          <div class="wx-bar"><div class="col" style="height:{{core.wuxing_pct.水}}%;background:var(--azure)"></div><div class="name">水</div><div class="num-val num">{{core.wuxing.水}}</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ CHARTS: ZIWEI 12-PALACE + BAZI ============ -->
  <div class="charts-grid">
    <!-- ZIWEI -->
    <div class="ziwei-pan">
      <h3>紫微斗数 · 十二宫盘 <small>生年四化：<span class="sh-禄">禄朱砂</span> / <span class="sh-权">权青蓝</span> / <span class="sh-科">科翠绿</span> / <span class="sh-忌">忌玄黑</span></small></h3>
      <div class="ziwei-grid">
        <!-- 巳 兄弟 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.巳.flag}}" data-zhi="巳">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">巳</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.巳.name}}</span>{{gongs.巳.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.巳.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.巳.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.巳.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.巳.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.巳.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 午 命宫 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.午.flag}}" data-zhi="午">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">午</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.午.name}}</span>{{gongs.午.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.午.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.午.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.午.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.午.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.午.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 未 父母 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.未.flag}}" data-zhi="未">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">未</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.未.name}}</span>{{gongs.未.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.未.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.未.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.未.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.未.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.未.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 申 福德 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.申.flag}}" data-zhi="申">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">申</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.申.name}}</span>{{gongs.申.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.申.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.申.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.申.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.申.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.申.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 辰 夫妻(身) -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.辰.flag}}" data-zhi="辰">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">辰</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.辰.name}}</span>{{gongs.辰.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.辰.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.辰.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.辰.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.辰.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.辰.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- center palace 2x2 -->
        <div class="center-palace">
          <h4>中宫 · 命盘信息</h4>
          <div class="info-line">{{meta.yinyang}} {{ziwei.wuxing_ju}}</div>
          <div class="info-line">命主：{{ziwei.ming_zhu}}　身主：{{ziwei.shen_zhu}}</div>
          <div class="pillars">
            <div class="pillar"><div class="pname">年</div><div class="pgan">{{bazi.year.gan}}</div><div class="pzhi">{{bazi.year.zhi}}</div></div>
            <div class="pillar"><div class="pname">月</div><div class="pgan">{{bazi.month.gan}}</div><div class="pzhi">{{bazi.month.zhi}}</div></div>
            <div class="pillar"><div class="pname">日</div><div class="pgan">{{bazi.day.gan}}</div><div class="pzhi">{{bazi.day.zhi}}</div></div>
            <div class="pillar"><div class="pname">时</div><div class="pgan">{{bazi.hour.gan}}</div><div class="pzhi">{{bazi.hour.zhi}}</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- 酉 田宅 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.酉.flag}}" data-zhi="酉">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">酉</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.酉.name}}</span>{{gongs.酉.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.酉.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.酉.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.酉.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.酉.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.酉.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 卯 子女(来因) -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.卯.flag}}" data-zhi="卯">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">卯</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.卯.name}}</span>{{gongs.卯.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.卯.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.卯.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.卯.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.卯.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.卯.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 戌 官禄 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.戌.flag}}" data-zhi="戌">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">戌</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.戌.name}}</span>{{gongs.戌.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.戌.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.戌.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.戌.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.戌.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.戌.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 寅 财帛 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.寅.flag}}" data-zhi="寅">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">寅</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.寅.name}}</span>{{gongs.寅.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.寅.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.寅.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.寅.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.寅.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.寅.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 丑 疾厄 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.丑.flag}}" data-zhi="丑">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">丑</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.丑.name}}</span>{{gongs.丑.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.丑.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.丑.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.丑.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.丑.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.丑.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 子 迁移 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.子.flag}}" data-zhi="子">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">子</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.子.name}}</span>{{gongs.子.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.子.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.子.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.子.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.子.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.子.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- 亥 交友 -->
        <div class="palace {{gongs.亥.flag}}" data-zhi="亥">
          <div class="p-head"><span class="p-dizhi">亥</span><span class="p-gong">{{gongs.亥.name}}</span>{{gongs.亥.shenBadge}}<span class="p-ganzhi">{{gongs.亥.ganzhi}}</span></div>
          <div class="main-star">{{gongs.亥.mainStarsHtml}}</div>
          <div class="aux-star">{{gongs.亥.auxStars}}</div>
          <div class="small-star">{{gongs.亥.smallStars}}</div>
          <div class="daxian">大限 {{gongs.亥.daxian_range}}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- BAZI -->
    <div class="bazi-pan">
      <h3>八字四柱盘 <small>藏干含十神 / 星运 / 自坐 / 纳音</small></h3>
      <div class="bazi-body">
        <div class="bazi-pillars">
          <div class="b-col">
            <div class="b-head">年柱</div>
            <div class="b-shishen">{{bazi.year.shiShen}}</div>
            <div class="b-gan">{{bazi.year.gan}}</div>
            <div class="b-zhi">{{bazi.year.zhi}}</div>
            <div class="b-canggan">{{bazi.year.cangGanHtml}}</div>
            <div class="b-extra">
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">星运</span><span>{{bazi.year.zhangSheng}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">自坐</span><span>{{bazi.year.ziZuo}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">纳音</span><span>{{bazi.year.naYin}}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="b-col">
            <div class="b-head">月柱</div>
            <div class="b-shishen">{{bazi.month.shiShen}}</div>
            <div class="b-gan">{{bazi.month.gan}}</div>
            <div class="b-zhi">{{bazi.month.zhi}}</div>
            <div class="b-canggan">{{bazi.month.cangGanHtml}}</div>
            <div class="b-extra">
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">星运</span><span>{{bazi.month.zhangSheng}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">自坐</span><span>{{bazi.month.ziZuo}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">纳音</span><span>{{bazi.month.naYin}}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="b-col">
            <div class="b-head">日柱</div>
            <div class="b-shishen dayMaster">日主</div>
            <div class="b-gan">{{bazi.day.gan}}</div>
            <div class="b-zhi">{{bazi.day.zhi}}</div>
            <div class="b-canggan">{{bazi.day.cangGanHtml}}</div>
            <div class="b-extra">
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">星运</span><span>{{bazi.day.zhangSheng}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">自坐</span><span>{{bazi.day.ziZuo}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">纳音</span><span>{{bazi.day.naYin}}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="b-col">
            <div class="b-head">时柱</div>
            <div class="b-shishen">{{bazi.hour.shiShen}}</div>
            <div class="b-gan">{{bazi.hour.gan}}</div>
            <div class="b-zhi">{{bazi.hour.zhi}}</div>
            <div class="b-canggan">{{bazi.hour.cangGanHtml}}</div>
            <div class="b-extra">
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">星运</span><span>{{bazi.hour.zhangSheng}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">自坐</span><span>{{bazi.hour.ziZuo}}</span></div>
              <div class="b-extra-row"><span class="ek">纳音</span><span>{{bazi.hour.naYin}}</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- DAYUN -->
        <div class="dayun-strip">
          <div class="strip-head">大运 <span class="small">(起运 {{bazi.dayunStart}} 岁)</span></div>
          <div class="strip-row">
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.0.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.0.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.0.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.0.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.1.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.1.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.1.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.1.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.2.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.2.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.2.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.2.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.3.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.3.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.3.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.3.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.4.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.4.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.4.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.4.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.5.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.5.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.5.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.5.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.6.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.6.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.6.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.6.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.7.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.7.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.7.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.7.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.8.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.8.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.8.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.8.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{dayun.9.current_class}}"><div class="gz">{{dayun.9.gz}}</div><div class="ages num">{{dayun.9.age_range}}</div><div class="ss">{{dayun.9.shishen}}</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- LIUNIAN -->
        <div class="liunian-strip">
          <div class="strip-head">流年 <span class="small">(当前大运：{{liunian_dayun_label}})</span></div>
          <div class="strip-row">
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.0.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.0.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.0.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.0.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.0.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.1.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.1.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.1.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.1.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.1.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.2.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.2.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.2.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.2.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.2.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.3.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.3.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.3.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.3.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.3.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.4.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.4.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.4.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.4.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.4.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.5.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.5.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.5.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.5.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.5.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.6.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.6.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.6.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.6.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.6.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.7.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.7.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.7.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.7.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.7.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.8.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.8.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.8.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.8.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.8.shishen}}</div></div>
            <div class="strip-cell {{liunian.9.current_class}}"><div class="ages num">{{liunian.9.year}}</div><div class="ages num">{{liunian.9.age}}</div><div class="gz">{{liunian.9.gz}}</div><div class="ss">{{liunian.9.shishen}}</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ NUMBERED SECTIONS ============ -->

  <div class="row-2col">
    <!-- 01 主轴印证结论 -->
    <section class="section">
      <h2><span class="num-box">01</span>主轴印证结论</h2>
      <div class="axis-conclusion">
        {{section_01.text}}
        <div class="wc">字数：{{section_01.word_count}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- 02 阶段印证时间轴 -->
    <section class="section">
      <h2><span class="num-box">02</span>阶段印证时间轴 <small style="font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:normal">（水平双轨）</small></h2>
      <div class="stage-legend">
        <span><span class="dot up"></span>关键上升期</span>
        <span><span class="dot flat"></span>调整期</span>
        <span><span class="dot down"></span>压力期</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stage-grid">
        <div class="sg-label">八字大运</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.0.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.1.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.2.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head {{section_02.bazi.3.current_class}}">{{section_02.bazi.3.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.4.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.5.range}}</div>
        <div class="stage-head">{{section_02.bazi.6.range}}</div>

        <div class="sg-label">八字大运</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.0.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.0.shishen}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.1.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.1.shishen}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.2.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.2.shishen}}</div>
        <div class="{{section_02.bazi.3.current_class}}">{{section_02.bazi.3.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.3.shishen}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.4.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.4.shishen}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.5.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.5.shishen}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.bazi.6.gz}}<br>{{section_02.bazi.6.shishen}}</div>

        <div class="sg-label">紫微大限</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.0.range}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.1.range}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.2.range}}</div>
        <div class="{{section_02.ziwei.3.current_class}}">{{section_02.ziwei.3.range}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.4.range}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.5.range}}</div>
        <div>{{section_02.ziwei.6.range}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stage-conclusion">
        <b>印证结论：</b>{{section_02.conclusion}}
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <!-- 03 六维交叉对账 + 04 冲突清单 -->
  <div class="row-2col">
    <section class="section">
      <h2><span class="num-box">03</span>六维交叉对账</h2>
      <div class="cross-grid">
        <div class="ch"></div>
        <div class="ch">事业</div><div class="ch">财运</div><div class="ch">婚恋</div>
        <div class="ch">子女</div><div class="ch">六亲</div><div class="ch">健康</div>

        <div class="lh">八字观点</div>
        <div>{{dim.career.bazi}}</div><div>{{dim.wealth.bazi}}</div><div>{{dim.marriage.bazi}}</div>
        <div>{{dim.children.bazi}}</div><div>{{dim.family.bazi}}</div><div>{{dim.health.bazi}}</div>

        <div class="lh">紫微观点</div>
        <div>{{dim.career.ziwei}}</div><div>{{dim.wealth.ziwei}}</div><div>{{dim.marriage.ziwei}}</div>
        <div>{{dim.children.ziwei}}</div><div>{{dim.family.ziwei}}</div><div>{{dim.health.ziwei}}</div>

        <div class="lh">印证标记</div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.career.verdict_class}}">{{dim.career.verdict}}</span></div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.wealth.verdict_class}}">{{dim.wealth.verdict}}</span></div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.marriage.verdict_class}}">{{dim.marriage.verdict}}</span></div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.children.verdict_class}}">{{dim.children.verdict}}</span></div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.family.verdict_class}}">{{dim.family.verdict}}</span></div>
        <div><span class="verdict-tag {{dim.health.verdict_class}}">{{dim.health.verdict}}</span></div>

        <div class="lh">融合结论</div>
        <div>{{dim.career.fused}}</div><div>{{dim.wealth.fused}}</div><div>{{dim.marriage.fused}}</div>
        <div>{{dim.children.fused}}</div><div>{{dim.family.fused}}</div><div>{{dim.health.fused}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section">
      <h2><span class="num-box">04</span>冲突清单 <small style="font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:normal">（已识别的主要冲突点）</small></h2>
      <div class="conflict-grid">
        <div class="ch">冲突点</div>
        <div class="ch">八字视角</div>
        <div class="ch">紫微视角</div>
        <div class="ch">影响程度</div>
        <div class="ch">建议</div>

        <div>{{conflicts.0.point}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.0.bazi}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.0.ziwei}}</div>
        <div><span class="impact-dot impact-{{conflicts.0.impact_class}}"></span>{{conflicts.0.impact}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.0.advice}}</div>

        <div>{{conflicts.1.point}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.1.bazi}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.1.ziwei}}</div>
        <div><span class="impact-dot impact-{{conflicts.1.impact_class}}"></span>{{conflicts.1.impact}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.1.advice}}</div>

        <div>{{conflicts.2.point}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.2.bazi}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.2.ziwei}}</div>
        <div><span class="impact-dot impact-{{conflicts.2.impact_class}}"></span>{{conflicts.2.impact}}</div>
        <div>{{conflicts.2.advice}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <!-- 05 综合定论 -->
  <section class="section">
    <h2><span class="num-box">05</span>综合定论</h2>
    <div class="final-grid">
      <div class="final-block">
        <h4>终极主轴</h4>
        <div class="big">{{final.life_axis}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="final-block">
        <h4>5 个关键节点（人生里程碑）</h4>
        <ul class="nodes-list">
          <li>{{final.nodes.0.age}}岁（{{final.nodes.0.year}}）：{{final.nodes.0.event}}</li>
          <li>{{final.nodes.1.age}}岁（{{final.nodes.1.year}}）：{{final.nodes.1.event}}</li>
          <li>{{final.nodes.2.age}}岁（{{final.nodes.2.year}}）：{{final.nodes.2.event}}</li>
          <li>{{final.nodes.3.age}}岁（{{final.nodes.3.year}}）：{{final.nodes.3.event}}</li>
          <li>{{final.nodes.4.age}}岁（{{final.nodes.4.year}}）：{{final.nodes.4.event}}</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="final-block">
        <h4>3 个高风险窗口 <small style="color:var(--ink-faint)">（需谨慎）</small></h4>
        <div class="risk-item"><span class="head">{{final.risks.0.range}}</span><br>{{final.risks.0.desc}}</div>
        <div class="risk-item"><span class="head">{{final.risks.1.range}}</span><br>{{final.risks.1.desc}}</div>
        <div class="risk-item"><span class="head">{{final.risks.2.range}}</span><br>{{final.risks.2.desc}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="final-block">
        <h4>2 条优势放大策略</h4>
        <div class="leverage-item"><span class="head">▸ {{final.leverage.0.title}}</span><br>{{final.leverage.0.desc}}</div>
        <div class="leverage-item"><span class="head">▸ {{final.leverage.1.title}}</span><br>{{final.leverage.1.desc}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="final-block">
        <h4>行动建议清单 <small style="color:var(--ink-faint)">（优先级）</small></h4>
        <div class="advice-item"><span class="num">1</span>{{final.advice.0}}</div>
        <div class="advice-item"><span class="num">2</span>{{final.advice.1}}</div>
        <div class="advice-item"><span class="num">3</span>{{final.advice.2}}</div>
        <div class="advice-item"><span class="num">4</span>{{final.advice.3}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 06 置信度 -->
  <section class="section">
    <h2><span class="num-box">06</span>置信度自评 <small style="font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:normal">（综合模型不确定性）</small></h2>
    <div class="confidence-row">
      <div class="conf-card">
        <div class="label">八字模型置信度</div>
        <div class="level">{{confidence.bazi_level}}</div>
        <div class="score">({{confidence.bazi_score}})</div>
      </div>
      <div class="conf-card">
        <div class="label">紫微模型置信度</div>
        <div class="level">{{confidence.ziwei_level}}</div>
        <div class="score">({{confidence.ziwei_score}})</div>
      </div>
      <div class="conf-card">
        <div class="label">两盘印证一致性</div>
        <div class="level">{{confidence.consistency_level}}</div>
        <div class="score">({{confidence.consistency_score}})</div>
      </div>
      <div class="conf-card">
        <div class="label">关键结论稳定性</div>
        <div class="level">{{confidence.stability_level}}</div>
        <div class="score">({{confidence.stability_score}})</div>
      </div>
      <div class="conf-note">
        <b>说明：</b>{{confidence.note}}
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ FOOTER ============ -->
  <div class="footer-disclaim">
    <span>① 命理分析仅供参考，不构成任何决策依据。人生的方向掌握在自己手中。　　✉ 混沌 · 命理研究</span>
    <span class="footer-seal">混沌<br>阁</span>
  </div>

</div>
</body>
</html>
```

## /server/src/utils/types.ts

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

export const CreateChartSchema = z.object({
  visitor_id: z.string().min(1),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  gender: z.enum(['男', '女']),
  calendar: z.enum(['公历', '农历']).default('农历'),
  birthday: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}$/),
  birthPlace: z.string().optional().default(''),
  currentPlace: z.string().optional().default(''),
  persona: z.enum(['standard', 'casual']).optional().default('standard'),
  depth: z.enum(['brief', 'detail']).optional().default('brief'),
});

export type CreateChartInput = z.infer<typeof CreateChartSchema>;

export interface ChartResultData {
  posterHtml: string;
  posterUrl: string;
  freeContent: {
    bazi: Record<string, unknown>;
    ziwei: Record<string, unknown>;
    keywords: string[];
  };
  unlockDescription: Array<{ title: string; desc: string }>;
}

```
